data.one_liner: An adapter package that provides yx_scope widgets for Flutter UI integration.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter widgets such as ScopeProvider, ScopeBuilder, ScopeListener, and ScopeConsumer to integrate yx_scope dependency management into the widget tree. It passes scopes down the tree and rebuilds widgets or triggers side effects in response to scope changes.
use_when: You are already using yx_scope for dependency management in your application
You need to provide scopes down the Flutter widget tree using InheritedWidget
You want to rebuild widgets or trigger side effects based on scope state changes
avoid_when: You are not using the yx_scope package
You prefer a different dependency injection solution like get_it or provider
strengths: Seamless integration between yx_scope and Flutter UI
Reduces boilerplate using widgets like ScopeConsumer
Supports fine-grained widget rebuilding and lifecycle listening
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the yx_scope ecosystem
Limited documentation outside of the repository introduction
data.setup_notes: Requires adding yx_scope and yx_scope_flutter to dependencies and wrapping your app or subtree with ScopeProvider.
